description: This file implements microphone input handling for Windows UWP platform, including device enumeration, audio graph setup, microphone processing, and interface implementation for the Cobalt project.

classes.name: MutedTrigger
classes.description: Utility class to detect if microphone has been muted for a specified duration.

classes.name: MicrophoneProcessor
classes.description: Encapsulates Windows audio API to manage microphone devices, process audio data, and mix into PCM stream.

classes.name: MicrophoneImpl
classes.description: Implements the SbMicrophonePrivate interface, manages microphone lifecycle and data reading.

methods.name: TryCreateAndStartRecording
methods.description: Attempts to create and start microphone processing with specified max samples and sample rate.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the microphone for recording if not already open.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the microphone and releases resources.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads PCM audio data from the microphone buffer.
